name: PinnerPress – Customizable Pin Buttons for Pinterest Creators
author: PinnerPress

sections.description:
PinnerPress is the most customizable Pinterest plugin for WordPress, designed to optimize your Pinterest strategy and drive more traffic to your site.

Powerful Features

  • Call Out Banners – Add eye-catching banners at the top or bottom of your pages to encourage readers to save content for later.
  • Image Control – Disable pinning on specific images while encouraging pins on others with custom settings.
  • Custom Pin Button – Add stylish Pin It buttons to all images with customizable design and placement options.
  • Custom CTA Banners – Add custom call-to-action banners below every image to increase engagement.
  • Follow Button – Add a Pinterest follow button anywhere on your site to grow your audience.
  • Hidden Pins – Create hidden pins that only appear when users engage with the Pinterest button.
  • Repin Attribution – Use data-pin-id to track repins and get better engagement metrics for your content.

How PinnerPress Works

  1. Install & Activate – Download PinnerPress, install it on your WordPress site, and activate the plugin.
  2. Configure Settings – Customize your Pinterest settings, button designs, and pin descriptions.
  3. Watch Traffic Grow – Enjoy increased Pinterest engagement and traffic to your WordPress site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Configure your plugin settings
sections.faq:
Is PinnerPress compatible with my theme?

Yes, PinnerPress is designed to work with any WordPress theme. Our plugin uses clean, standard code that integrates seamlessly with your existing design.

Do I need a Pinterest business account?

While not required, we recommend using a Pinterest business account to access analytics and additional features that work well with PinnerPress.

Will PinnerPress slow down my website?

No, PinnerPress is optimized for performance. The plugin loads resources efficiently and only when needed to ensure your site remains fast.

How do I set up rich pins?

PinnerPress makes it easy to set up rich pins. Simply enable the feature in the plugin settings, and we’ll add the necessary metadata to your content for Pinterest to recognize it.

Do you offer support if I need help?

Yes, pro plan subscribers get priority support.
